channel.title: Shaun the Sheep
channel.desc: The Farmer is preparing for a date. He wants to look his best so it's time to dust off his prized hairpiece. Shaun can't resist trying the wig on but loses it while showing off to the flock. The race is on as Shaun and Bitzer try to return the wig in time for the Farmer's big night.
